title: Matrix NAP Info Boosts Terabit-Era Submarine Connectivity with Ciena WaveLogic 6 Extreme on the Batam–Jakarta Corridor
summary: 1 Tb/s per-wavelength deployment on the Matrix Cable System positions Indonesia at the forefront of next-generation digital connectivity Matrix Networks Pte Ltd ( Matrix Networks ) and PT NAP Info Lintas Nusa ( NAP Info ), strategic partners in the operation of the Matrix Cable System (collectively "Matrix NAP Info"), today announced the successful activation of Ciena’s (NYSE: CIEN) GeoMesh Extreme solution, powered by WaveLogic 6 Extreme ( WL6e ) coherent optical technology, across the Batam–Jakarta segment of the Matrix Cable System (MCS). The deployment establishes Matrix NAP Info as one of the first operators in the region to commercially activate the latest generation of Ciena’s coherent optical technology on a live submarine cable system, delivering 1 Tb/s per wavelength channel across the 1,055 km link.
